status: Specified before measurement. Fresh policy seeds and three separately authored scenarios; local prospective validation, not public preregistration.
hypothesis: Assess whether original and additive learning effects persist in separately specified cover/spawn scenarios and fresh policy seeds. Run both regardless of development outcome.

reference.note: New actual combats for every rule/seed/world; only immutable simulator/core reused. Fixed traces executed once per world, never counted as independent seed repeats.

reward.team_evidence: Sum damage from other roles with a legitimate sighting. Own observation gate unchanged. Original personal damage scale, cost, defeat penalty and clamp retained. No player style enters the reward.
reward.choice: One additive candidate; same teammate increment as rejected blend, full personal credit retained; no weight sweep.

uncertainty.method: Paired percentile bootstrap of per-seed mean differences; never resample individual rounds as independent units.
uncertainty.scope: Intervals describe policy-sampling variation over these fixed controllers and the equal-weight mean of three authored scenarios; not a population of maps or people.

branching: For each rule, seed and scenario, train 24 clockwise rounds; branch online/frozen from identical rule-specific snapshot into 24 reversal rounds and independent 24 feint rounds. Fresh physical state at every branch. Every first combat must match within the online/frozen pair.

gates.decision: Generalization screen requires all four aggregate gates plus no scenario mean loss worse than 6 HP against original. Promotion also requires all additive-credit-v1 development gates. Keep both outcomes even if either screen fails.

secondary_metrics: Four-round damage curves and early/late windows
Damage against a fixed baseline selected only on clockwise calibration across these three scenarios
Accepted rewards, own and observed-team damage, defeat state for every feedback
invariants: Original v1 evidence and hashed sources remain unchanged

Scenario geometry and enemy spawn coordinates change as specified; within each scenario only host reward attribution differs. Stats, weapons, tactics, learner config, controllers and observation rules are identical.
No player style label is supplied to reward computation or policy
Candidate feedback and displayed recorded rewards must agree
Frozen memories are exact; first combat matches within each online/frozen pair
All seeds, rounds and failures retained; never overwrite evidence
limits: Only policy sampling is seeded; three authored scenarios and known scripted controllers.
Fixed baseline selected only on clockwise calibration in these three scenarios, not reverse or feint.
Rewards describe effectiveness, not fun; human experience remains unmeasured.
Team credit is not a causal contribution estimator and can credit a noncontributing teammate.
Intervals describe policy-seed variation, not people or a population of maps; secondary analyses exploratory.
A favorable result permits the next evaluation, not a broad public effectiveness claim.
No scout/report condition or engine integration is tested.

archive.purpose: Immutable source, generated Wasm/simulator, and raw evidence for adaptation-v1 and reward-attribution-v1 before the app advances.

fixed_baseline.calibration: One clockwise encounter in each of the three scenarios; choose global equal-weight winner, tie lexical id. No reverse/feint selection outcomes used.

analysis: Report each scenario, plus paired bootstrap over 16 seed-level means averaged equally across the three scenarios. The three authored worlds are not independent samples from a map population. Secondary comparisons exploratory.
